title: Platform control plane — standup notes Mar 9-13 2026
content:
Week summary (Mar 9–13, 2026) — quick roundup and per-day standup logs. High-level status: control plane stability improving, routing policy MVP in canary, quotas bug triaged but still blocking some tenant restores, auth team landed short-lived token rotation prototype. Lots of small follow-ups; see actions below.

Attendees (rotating): Aisha, Diego, Sofia, Ethan, Lina, + on-call rotation (Garcia).

MON 2026-03-09 — Kickoff sync
- Highlights:
  - Control plane DB migration (PLAT-2013): schema migration plan approved; offline read window scheduled for Sat 3/21 UTC. Diego ran smoke tests against the migration harness, saw a deadlock case on parallel index creation (fixed in branch).
  - Routing: initial policy rules for latency-first routing are live in staging; we can route to v2q (quantized) variants for non-LLM-chat workloads.
  - Auth: prototype for rotating short-lived tokens (15m default) merged to feature branch; integration with KMS in progress.
  - Quotas: observed tenants with quota resets after autoscaler restarts — created PLAT-2087 to track.
- Blockers:
  - Quota service persists state to ephemeral store in some failure paths; need durable persistence.
- Action items:
  - Diego: finish migration runbook PR and add step to reindex after downtime (due 3/16).
  - Sofia: add canary e2e test for routing policy that exercises fallback to hosted-models (due 3/12).

TUE 2026-03-10 — Deep-dive, 30m
- Notes:
  - Migration: confirmed backfill job throughput is ~1.2M keys/hour on staging; estimate 6–8 hour maintenance window for prod tenant with 6M keys. Consider sharding backfill.
  - Routing: found a bug where routing table updates applied out-of-order during concurrent rollouts — caused transient 503s for small % of requests. Patch submitted (PR #812).
  - Auth: token rotation prototype uncovered an edge case with long-poll websocket sessions losing auth; need session re-auth path.
  - Quotas: added a short-term monitoring alert (quota-service:counter-drop) to detect resets; we caught two incidents overnight.
- Decisions:
  - Roll forward with canary for us-west2 for 48h, monitor p95 and error-rate closely. If >1% error spike, automatic rollback.
  - For migration, prefer rolling back to snapshot if backfill fails mid-run rather than attempt incremental repair. Documented in runbook.
- Blockers/risks:
  - On-call capacity next week limited (vacation), adjust rollback thresholds to be conservative.
- Action items:
  - Ethan: add session re-auth hook for websockets and spike test (due 3/17).
  - Lina: add persistent store adapters to quota-service (Redis -> Cockroach migration plan) (due 3/19).

WED 2026-03-11 — Quick status check
- Highlights:
  - PR #812 merged to staging; routing out-of-order update fixed. Observed 0.1% error rate vs 0.8% previously in canary.
  - Quota monitoring dashboard added (Grafana) with historical comparison; dashboards linked in artifacts.
- Open issues:
  - Auth websocket re-auth needs infra changes (session tokens must be refreshable without full reconnect). Not urgent but needs design.
- Notes to self:
  - We should consider issuing a short note to customer-success about expected maintenance window for migration (tentative 3/21). Draft in Slack: "planning ctrl-plane maintenance Sat 3/21 UTC — reduced throughput for up to 6–8 hours; we'll send final notice once window confirmed."
- Action items:
  - Aisha: draft customer notice and share with CS for review (due 3/12).

THU 2026-03-12 — Planning + retro of recent incidents
- Incident retro (quota resets):
  - Root cause: quota-service had unreliable flush to persistent store under driver reconnect (identified by Lina). On restart the service rehydrated counters from stale cache, causing resets.
  - Mitigations: immediate patch to mark rehydrate as read-only until full sync completed; alert on rehydrate_complete metric. Postmortem draft started (PLAT-2087).
- Routing policy notes:
  - New policy supports two dimensions: latency_tier and cost_tier. Default: latency_tier=standard, cost_tier=balanced. We route to v2q when latency_tier != 'ultra'. Encourage teams to opt-in via per-route annotation.
- Auth:
  - Decided: default short-lived tokens 15m; support explicit long-lived session tokens for integrations (documented and audited). Need to wire up KMS rotation.
- Decision log:
  - Canary rollout length extended to 72h for routing changes to give more headroom on weekend with reduced staff.
- Action items:
  - Sofia: publish routing policy docs and example annotation snippets (due 3/15).
  - Diego + Lina: finalize quota persistence migration plan and schedule one soak in staging (due 3/18).

FRI 2026-03-13 — End-of-week sync, quick wins
- Wins:
  - Routing canary stable after two days; p95 latency within SLO (p95 <= 50ms for control-plane RPCs), error rate stable ~0.12%.
  - Postmortem draft for quota resets mostly complete; added timeline and proposed owner assignments.
- Remaining risks/notes:
  - DB migration still on the calendar for 3/21; need final thumbs-up from infra/security for maintenance window. Add extra rollback rehearsals next week.
- Action items (recap):
  - Diego: migration runbook + dry-run checklist (3/16).
  - Lina: quota persistence adapter PR + staging soak (3/18).
  - Ethan: websocket session re-auth spike + unit tests (3/17).
  - Sofia: routing docs + canary observability checks (3/15).
  - Aisha: customer notice draft + approvals (3/12) — done, CS reviewed, waiting on legal opt-in.

Outstanding questions / parking lot:
- Do we want per-model quota overrides to be soft-limited (warning) or hard-limited during migration period? (tentative: soft-limit during migration week).
- How to best expose routing annotations to external customers via API without leaking internal variant names? (need API/SDK design discussion).

Misc notes & scratchpad (informal):
- Quick grep commands I used: 
  - "rg 'hydrate' services/quota* -n" — found rehydrate call in quota-service main.go
  - db migration test harness: run with MIGRATE_PARALLEL=4 to simulate heavy load
- Quick checklist for Saturday maintenance (to copy into runbook):
  - Snapshot cockroach cluster at T-2h
  - Put control-plane into read_only mode (announce 30m prior)
  - Run backfill with shard=8; monitor backfill progress metric (backfill.progress.percent)
  - Post-checks: sanity RUNNER health, routing table sanity; smoke generation of 1k requests/tenant

Decisions made this week (short list):
- Routing canary extended to 72h (conservative ops posture).
- Default token TTL = 15m; explicit audited long-lived tokens for integrations.
- Migration rollback strategy: restore snapshot if backfill fails.

Postmortem & docs links (working):
- PLAT-2087 (quota reset incident) — postmortem draft in Confluence
- PR #812 (routing out-of-order fix) — staging verified
- Migration runbook (draft) — runbook link in artifacts

Next week focus (3/16–3/20): finalize migration runbook + rehearsals, finish quota persistence migration and staging soak, implement websocket re-auth flow and tests, publish routing docs, and prepare customer communications for 3/21 maintenance.

-- end of standup roundup (notes/half-formed thoughts saved here).
